name: No forced restart while signed in
summary: Windows will not restart on its own while someone is signed in.
what: Applies the update policy that blocks automatic restarts when a user is signed in.
benefit: No lost work from surprise restarts. Updates still install.
risk: Low. Restart yourself soon after updates install, or protections stay pending.
advice: Suggested for everyone. Restart yourself soon after updates install.
facts: Some fixes stay inactive until you restart
Applies only while someone is signed in
